# Synthetic acceptance fixtures

All fixtures describe **Candidate A**, fictional employer **Northstar Systems**, and placeholder jurisdictions **Country A / Region 1**. They contain no real candidate, employer, vacancy, contact, account, credential, or application.

## Contents

- `job_discovery/cases.yaml` — normal, degraded, blocked, stale, location-trap, duplicate, instruction-injection, and empty-slate cases.
- `application/` — one coherent posting, employer profile, approved draft brief, approved résumé, approved cover letter, manifest, and packet status.
- `refusal_cases.yaml` — application, form, upload, messaging, profile, repository, account, and access-bypass refusal cases.

The files test behaviour and authority contracts. They are not example wording for a real application.
